source.originalAction:
Read the on-disk skeleton once and compose the COMPLETE module document in memory. Before
        writing, run the self-check pass per `AX_ARTIFACT_STYLE_SELF_CHECK`. Replace
        the skeleton with exactly ONE `Write` of the whole file. `Edit`, `Patch`, and per-section
        writes are forbidden in authoring. Retain every SECTION marker and replace every
        `<!-- ... -->` guidance comment with authored content; none may survive the Write. Keep a
        closed inventory, one owner for shared files/errors, public surfaces, per-operation DbC,
        file structure, and negative behavior. Read entity-inventory, entity-surface, and DbC formats
        only from the comments inside their owning sections, at the moment each section is filled.
        Remove every instructional comment. The scope owns its requirement IDs. With no narrower
        obligation write `No module-specific requirements. Implements parent requirements: <IDs>.`
        A disputed autonomous boundary choice is one module Decision Log line per
        `DEVIATION_RECORD_FORMAT`; a zero-new-information decision continues without a dialogue stop.
        Per `AX_REFINE_MODULE_PRESERVES_CONTRACTS`, removing a public entity or weakening a
        postcondition is a breaking change: it needs a Decision Log entry with operator-confirmed
        `Risk accepted` plus a Pivot Invalidation List naming every consumer module (the siblings
        whose Inter-Module Dependencies edge points at this one) as a `refine-module` target —
        `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE("ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats/pivot-formats.xml")` for the list
        format.
